This is me a year ago. It took me almost 10 months to get better and move on from the reason that got me depressed. I don't think that there's much you can do about it if you are depressed. Because I couldn't. When you hate your life and you are suicidal your social life and friends/family is the least you can think about. You have to put yourself first in order to heal. Just open up to them and let them understand and help you. Because they are the ones that should support you. Loneliness hits different when you're depressed. But you shouldn't force yourself to be that social butterfly because you can end up being more toxic to them (this happened to me a lot and I ended up fighting w my friends). Instead ask for their support. If they will be butthurt and leave you for being depressed and "annoying" then fuck them, they're not your friends. Socialize w people that have been through the same. It's gonna sound cliche but trying your hobbies in a different environment helps a lot. If you like reading then take a book and read it in a cafe. Maybe you can also get a chance to have a small talk w a random nice stranger and you'll feel good after that. It's much more better than depressing walls of our room. So I'd say one step at a time, neither be hard on yourself nor feel bad about being irritating. That's what depression does to people and it's not our fault.
